How we handle your data

We may use your content to improve our models. You can opt out of training in your data controls at any time.

Conversations may be reviewed by our staff to prevent abuse and misuse, in limited circumstances.

We retain deleted conversations for up to 30 days. Personal data is deleted within thirty days of account closure.

You can delete your account and your conversation history at any time in the settings.

Your data is stored in the United States, and we offer a data residency option for enterprise customers.

Our API is governed by separate commercial terms and a data processing addendum.
